name: [👿UPDATE7] Honey Piece
desc:
The legendary story of Honey Piece🍯 has begun. Will you be a brave bee or a fierce wasp? 
Find the power🔥 you need and become the strongest.💪🏻

Like👍 the game for more codes

This game is supports PC💻/Mobile📱/Console🎮

You can rejoin by typing "/rejoin" 💬

Level Caps : 6500 🎚️

[ControlLists PC💻/ Console🎮]
- Z , X , C , V , F / X , Y , B , D-Padup , D-Padright to use Skills 🤹🏻
- Q / LT to Dash 💨
- Double-Space / Double A to use Geppo 🦘
- Ctrl / D-Padleft to Sprint 👟
- LeftShift / D-Paddown to ShiftLock🎯
